detail.longDescription: I've been messing with GetSystemMetric function on VBA, trying to automate workbook zoom based on screen size. At the company I work, most monitors are FHD, however, due to actual screen size and user preference, people tend to personalize the zoom option on the Windows system. I've found solutions for one monitor, however, whenever I try those on my set up with a laptop and an external monitor I only get results for the main monitor for both zoom and size. I want to be able to get the results for whichever monitor my Excel sheet is active on. In summary, my two main problems are: Getting the size of each monitor conected to the machine Getting the zoom setting of each screen Basically getting these numbers:
